newsitem.title: USA: Alberto-Culver seeks increase in shares.
newsitem.headline: Alberto-Culver seeks increase in shares.

text.p: Alberto-Culver Co, in a proxy for its January 23 annual meeting, said it is seeking shareholder approval to increase the number of authorized shares of both Class A and B common stock to 75 million from 25 million.

The company said it has made no decisions on how the additional 50 million shares of each of Class A and B common would be used, but such a move would allow the board to effect a 100 percent stock dividend on both classes of common stock.
The personal care products company said having more shares would give it flexibility to take advantage of business and financial opportunities such as acquisitions.

The added shares also could be used to render more difficult or discourage a merger, tender offer or proxy contest or the assumption of control by a holder of a large block of the company's securities, it said.
On November 25, 1996, Alberto-Culver had 27.8 million common shares outstanding, of which 11.1 million were Class A and 16.8 million were Class B.
